description: One single full-body character for the SAME grounded modern supernatural investigation headquarters game as the style reference. Adult man late40s, short silver gray hair swept back, black sunglasses, angular confident smiling face, tall solid veteran build, black tailored trouser suit, white shirt, black necktie, black formal shoes. Relaxed upright standing, empty hands visible at sides, feet flat. Front-facing SOUTH, body and face straight toward viewer; camera slightly above eye level, LOW TOP-DOWN. Realistic natural human anatomy about 7 heads tall; normal head and visible neck; crotch 45-48 percent of total height above soles. No chibi, giant head, shortened neck or exaggerated long legs. Full head and shoes visible, 6px minimum top/bottom margin, target body height 230-238px on128x256; tall; preserve the described individual shoulder width, torso fullness and limb thickness, not the reference male body. Match reference precise native pixel density, selective dark outlines, controlled pixel shading and subdued interior lighting. Keep THIS character own hair, iris and clothing colors. Crisp native1px clusters, no antialiasing, transparent background, no floor or shadow, no text, no weapons or held props, one character only.

style_image.usage_description: Use ONLY pixel rendering, outline, shading and lighting. Do not copy the reference male height, body shape, shoulder width, outfit or identity. Preserve this character own stature, build, age, hair, irises and original clothing colors and silhouette. FRONT view.
